title: Measures converging against C_c to Hⁿ⌞P give mass ω_n to the closed unit ball in the limit (squeeze from parent Steps 3 and 7)
statement: Let n, N ∈ ℕ, let P ⊆ ℝ^N be a linear subspace with dim P = n, and let (ν_r)_{r∈ℝ} be Borel measures on ℝ^N such that (i) ν_r(B̄_2(0)) < ∞ for all sufficiently small r > 0, and (ii) for every f ∈ C_c(ℝ^N, ℝ), ∫ f dν_r → ∫_P f dHⁿ as r ↓ 0. Here Hⁿ = μHE[n] and ∫_P is the integral over the set P. Then ν_r(B̄_1(0)) → ω_n := Lⁿ(B_1(0)) in [0, ∞] as r ↓ 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (n N : ℕ) (ν : ℝ → Measure (Rn N)) (P : Submodule ℝ (Rn N)), finrank ℝ P = n → (∀ᶠ r in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), ν r (Metric.closedBall 0 2) < ∞) → (∀ f : C_c(Rn N, ℝ), Tendsto (fun r : ℝ ↦ ∫ y, f y ∂(ν r)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (∫ y in (P : Set (Rn N)), f y ∂μHE[n]))) → Tendsto (fun r : ℝ ↦ ν r (Metric.closedBall 0 1)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (volume (Metric.ball (0 : Rn n) 1)))
